mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_serial_log (material_id, serial_no, biz_type, doc_id, doc_no, direction, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{g.materialId}, #{g.serialNo}, #{g.bizType}, #{g.docId}, #{g.docNo}, #{g.direction}, #{g.warehouseId}, #{g.locationId}, #{g.batchNo}, #{g.createBy}, #{g.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.biz_type, g.doc_id, g.doc_no, g.direction, w.name AS warehouse_name, l.code AS location_code, g.batch_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name, g.create_time FROM wms_serial_log g JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = g.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = g.location_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = g.create_by WHERE g.material_id = #{materialId} AND g.serial_no = #{serialNo} ORDER BY g.id
